The Privacy Policy Generator is a legitimate utility designed to generate text templates for GDPR, CCPA, and standard privacy policies. It does not request credentials or perform network calls in the reviewed portions, so it is consistent with its stated purpose. Before installing or running: (1) review the remainder of scripts/privacy.sh (the provided excerpt was truncated) to confirm there are no hidden network calls or commands you don't expect; (2) run the script in a sandbox or non-production environment to verify output; (3) remember generated policies are templates and not legal advice—consult a qualified attorney before publishing; and (4) note the package owner and homepage are unknown, so exercise normal caution (review code) if you plan to use this for production/legal purposes.
